purpose: Focus and hover paint must not masquerade as a persistent selected cue.
method: The real selected Collapse left sidebar button was keyboard-focused during the actual dirty-project capture. Its selected pseudo-element background was temporarily made transparent, then restored; both runs retained the same focused control.

negative.result: selected-state-indicator failed for Collapse left sidebar; changed selection cues were empty even though its focus outline was 10.51:1 and ordinary border indicator was 5.21:1

restored.result: passed with the same control focused and the selected ::after marker measured as a changed cue
